title: AOS Live Use: Batch Log Ticks 121 & 122
abstract: Catching up on administrative tasks. Logging the actions from the controlled demolition and successful rebuild of the AOS.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

# Log for Tick 121
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=121, type="storage_delete", target="telos/aos_manager.py", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=121, type="submit", target="Log Tick 120 Failures", metadata={"eval_id": 270, "status": "failed", "reason": "ImportError after demolition"})

# Log for Tick 122
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=122, type="storage_write", target="telos/aos_manager.py", metadata={"action": "rebuild"})

print("Batch logging complete.")
